from: Three days ago, I went home and eat a sandwich.
to: Three days ago, I went home and ate a sandwich.
reason: Het werkwoord 'eat' moet in de verleden tijd 'ate' zijn.

from: I will be taking an exam later today, so I read my textbook last night.
to: I will be taking an exam later today, so I studied my textbook last night.
reason: De verleden tijd van 'read' is 'studied' in deze context.

from: I usually study on Fridays, but this week I have been studying every day.
to: I usually study on Fridays, but this week I have studied every day.
reason: El tiempo verbal 'have been studying' no es necesario aquí; 'have studied' es más apropiado para indicar una acción completada.
